The '''Sith war droid Mark I''' model was utilized by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|The Colicoid insects that built them installed a pointy-legged, shuffling locomotion system that leaves them vulnerable to flanking maneuvers.|[[Darth Malgus]]|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Sith war droid Mark I.png|thumb|left|300px|Sith war droids in battle]]
The Mark I Sith war droid moved on four legs, and was armed with arm&ndash;mounted [[blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]]. They were modeled after their Colicoid creators, like the [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] employed thousands of years later by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They appear to walk at a rather slower pace than other droids deployed at the time, most likely due to their heavy armor plating. On the contrary, Sith War Droids are capable of crossing much more rugged terrain than most regular droids of its time due to the pointed ends on their legs.

Unlike droidekas, Sith war droids do not possess a shield or any primary defense by default, but can and have been equipped with them in some cases.

==History==
[[Darth Malgus]] deployed these droids alongside [[Sith Warrior]]s to battle [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces during the [[Battle of Alderaan]] and later during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Maybe_a_Sith_war_droid_Mark_I.png|thumb|right|180px|The droid in "The Misadventures of Triple-Zero and Beetee".]]
Production renders by [[Blur Studio]] rendering artist [[Alessandro Baldasseroni]] label the droid as '''Colicoid Droid'''.<ref name="Colicoid">{{WebCite|url=https://www.eklettica.com/starwars.html|text=Starwars : The Old Republic - Modeling, texturing , surfacing|work=[[Alessandro Baldasseroni]]'s [https://alessandrobaldasseroni.com official website]|archivedate=20140805072948}}</ref> Following the rebranding of the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] into ''Star Wars'' Legends, a droid similar to the Sith war droid Mark I appeared in the [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story "[[The Misadventures of Triple-Zero and Beetee]]," which was published in the [[Darth Vader (2015) 20|twentieth issue]] of the comic series [[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2015)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'']].<ref name="DV20">[[Darth Vader (2015) 20|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 20]]</ref>
